representativeSnapshot.kind: Supabase project where Phase 1 promoter foundation has already been applied

rowCountQueries: event_promotion_programs and event_promotion_ticket_eligibility counts by event
ticket_types membership and active-state inventory by selected event
effective grants and policies for promoter program tables and audit events
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: Creates one additive audit table and one server-only SECURITY INVOKER command. Existing eligibility rows gain a nullable retirement marker without a backfill.

execution.resumeStrategy: All DDL is additive/idempotent. The command function is replaced atomically; no existing financial snapshots or ledger rows are rewritten.
execution.idempotency: The command locks the selected program, allocates the next version inside the same transaction, and uses the eligibility primary key for stable upserts. Client roles cannot execute the command.

quarantine.strategy: No tenant or organization backfill is performed. Event organization scope is resolved from events_v2 only during an already-authorized server command.

constraints: Audit events reference the existing promoter program and canonical events_v2 event
Client roles are denied all audit-event writes and command-function execution
Eligibility retirement preserves prior rows instead of deleting configuration evidence
constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Confirm an organizer can create, edit, open, and pause a program; confirm a non-organizer cannot read or write it; and confirm financial edits create exactly one newer version while the former snapshot remains unchanged.

recovery.rollback: Disable event_promoter_program_enabled. Preserve programs, versions, audit events, and retired eligibility rows.
recovery.forwardFix: Use a reviewed additive migration for a policy, function, or index correction; do not delete audit history or historical program versions.

queries: audit-event table RLS, grants, and organizer policy inventory
function execute grants must include service_role and exclude anon/authenticated
program version count before and after a commission or eligibility change
attempted direct authenticated writes to programs, versions, eligibility, and audit events must fail

exceptions.rationale: The SELECT only expands the validated JSON array supplied to the locked, already-authorized program command. It is not a backfill and cannot scan or affect unrelated existing rows.
exceptions.evidence: __tests__/promoter-network/domain.test.ts verifies the server-only audited command contract; postflight validates selected event ticket ownership.
